notes: Elevate Cannabis Belton (114 E North Ave, place_id ChIJuU906JzbwIcRSuJ2KAQudhY) closed July 31, 2024. Google still shows that listing as permanently closed with 4.9 stars and 1,050 reviews (live SERP, Nov 12, 2026). The store now trades as Key Cannabis Dispensary Belton, 225 N Cedar St; Key is Elevate's retail brand (Belton page heading: Fresh Premium Products from Elevate). The 2024 move notice said 255 N Cedar, but Google, the website, Dutchie and JointCommerce all show 225 N Cedar St. This audit uses the Key Cannabis listing.

elevatecannabis.com/shop/belton-mo/ returns 404 (DataForSEO page test, Nov 12, 2026). Direct fetch of the Elevate site was blocked by our network proxy, so the redirect chain could not be traced; Google's AI Overview cites keycannabis.com/shop/belton-mo/?source=ELV_Redirect.

Competitors were picked from the live local packs: Blue Sage (in all 5 packs), ReLeaf Grandview (2 packs), Codes Raymore (1 pack). Good Day Farm Belton is marked permanently closed in Google listing data (Nov 2025) and CLOVR, now at the same 17211 US-71 address, did not appear in any local pack, so neither was used.
AI answers still name Good Day Farm Belton (closed on Google) and CLOVR, and Perplexity and Claude list 'Elevate Missouri / Elevate Cannabis, 114 E North Ave' as an open store.

Google Ads returned no volume for any 'near me' phrase or for 'best dispensary belton mo' at Kansas City or Missouri level, so local phrases with volume were used; 'best dispensary belton mo' is kept with volume 0. Brand volume: 'key cannabis belton' 90/month in Kansas City (480/month statewide); 'elevate cannabis belton' returned no volume.

Google results were run with location 'Belton,Missouri,United States' because the SERP tool here has no coordinate option. No Google AI Overview appeared on any of the 6 Belton searches; one appeared for 'dispensary raymore mo' (named Codes, Blue Sage, Greenlight) and one for 'elevate cannabis belton' (said the store moved to Key Cannabis).

All four domains serve several locations (Key: Missouri, Illinois, Arizona; Blue Sage: Missouri, Kentucky; Codes and ReLeaf: several Missouri stores). Traffic, keyword and backlink numbers cover the whole domain, not just one store.
Traffic months are Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 (DataForSEO estimated organic visits, United States).
Price: Headset publishes a US average basket ($47.03, Oct 2025 to Sep 2026, excludes Florida) but no Missouri basket; its Missouri page gives an average item price of $26.56 (Oct 2026).
PR counts come from one web search per brand and are brand-wide, not store-level. Video counts: a 2023 YouTube video filmed at 225 N Cedar when it was Bloc Dispensary was not counted for Key.
ReLeaf homepage rendered 0 images in the page test (likely an age gate), so its alt text share is null.
Google profile details counts come from DataForSEO listing data last updated Sep 2026; ratings and review counts come from the live Nov 12, 2026 local pack.
